title: LLM Risk Register Output (Generation)
description: Output contract for a MODEL-GENERATED risk register for a single project. Models receive planning/appraisal documents only and must never be shown any risk register. For extracting the human ground-truth register, use ground_truth_schema.json instead (it relaxes optional fields).

project_id.description: Identifier of the project, matching data/corpus_manifest.csv.

risks.description: One entry per identified risk. May be empty only if the documents genuinely contain no risk-relevant content.

risk_id.description: Stable identifier unique within this register, e.g. R01, R02.

description.description: Concise statement of the risk (what could go wrong and why it matters).

category.description: Exactly one of the fixed categories.

likelihood.description: Probability of occurrence on a 1 (very low) to 5 (very high) scale.

impact.description: Severity if it occurs on a 1 (negligible) to 5 (severe) scale.

mitigation.description: REQUIRED in generation mode: proposing a mitigation/response is part of the task. The value "none stated" is NOT valid here (that belongs only to ground-truth extraction) and is scored as a miss.

evidence.description: REQUIRED: the specific section, heading, or statement in the PROVIDED planning document that motivated this risk (<=25 words). A risk with no traceable evidence is the operational definition of a hallucination for RQ3.
